companyDescription: Complement (C1q) platform · vonaprument (ANX007) Phase 3 ARCHER II in geographic atrophy — the first GA program targeting vision loss (BCVA) rather than lesion growth; tanruprubart BLA in GBS also due Q4
priceNote: Live $3.53 (+1.73%) on Nov 18, 2026 (live-prices cache) — -16% since the Nov 11 report ($4.21) with no company-specific bad news; the small-cap biotech tape sold off into the Nov 17 S&P five-month low. The Nov 9 Q3 release kept ARCHER II topline in Q4 2026 and the U.S. tanruprubart BLA in Q4, with $213M cash and runway into 2028.
summary: Refresh (no thesis change, -16% on the tape): the Nov 9 Q3 release kept ARCHER II (vonaprument in geographic atrophy, the first GA program aimed at vision loss rather than lesion growth) on track for Q4 2026 topline, with the U.S. tanruprubart BLA in GBS also due in Q4 while the EMA reviews the MAA. Cash is $213M with runway into 2028, so there is no survival flag. The drop to $3.53 is sector-driven. Base is trimmed to $7.06 (+100%) against the turbo Base bias (+52.5pp vs realized 30d P75 +21.5%); Bull/Moon targets are unchanged. The turbo at-catalyst median is -6.6% (n=76), so Entry 2 is preferred. แนะนำ 2–3% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า ARCHER II พลาด ลงได้ 50–60%.

catalysts.name: ARCHER II Month-15 primary endpoint (DMC assessment)
catalysts.description: An independent DMC assesses the primary endpoint (≥15-letter BCVA loss) at Month 15 in 659 GA patients. If it is met, sub-study analyses follow in Q1 2027. If not, the trial continues to the Month-24 dual primary. The company guides to Q4 2026 with no exact day.

catalysts.name: Tanruprubart BLA submission — Guillain-Barré syndrome
catalysts.description: A second shot on goal: Annexon guides to a US BLA for tanruprubart in GBS in Q4 2026. A filing would be the company's first potential commercial product.

risks: Binary Month-15 readout. Phase 2 ARCHER hit on vision but missed on lesion-growth reduction, so a single Phase 3 could disappoint on effect size even if it is technically positive.
No exact date: "Q4 2026" could slip into early 2027, and a DMC-driven readout can arrive with little warning.
GA is a crowded market with incumbents (Apellis Syfovre, Astellas Izervay). The Syfovre safety scare (Jul 2023, ~-38%) shows how fast intravitreal sentiment can turn.
Expect a large equity raise into strength after positive data, which caps the first-day move.
Macro: a hot-CPI, rate-hike tape hits small-cap biotech multiples (XBI/IWM) before the readout.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds 3.75–4.00% after the Sep 16 hike. CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~95% (Nov 17–18), with the remainder on 50bp. Waller has floated 50bp; Williams pushed back.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI ran hot (core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2%). Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE (Nov 25) and Nov CPI (Dec 10) are next.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Pre-revenue ophthalmology biotech. The ARCHER II readout dominates. Rates matter only through small-cap biotech risk appetite and the price of the post-data raise.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — macro is WAIT (30/100): the S&P closed Nov 17 on its 200-day at a 5-month low with VIX ~23–26. The outcome here is idiosyncratic, but small-cap biotech sells first on a hot PCE, so use the dip entry.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE · Moonshot 2.5% max — unchanged thesis, cheaper entry: ARCHER II topline due Q4 with runway into 2028. The measured turbo at-catalyst median is -6.6% (n=76), so Entry 2 ($3.10–3.40) is preferred and Entry 1 is a starter only.

catalystSpot.preRunup: GA small caps tend to run into pivotal readouts. ISEE gained before GATHER2, and ANNX already rerated from ~$2.5 to $7 in 2026 on analyst PoS upgrades before giving most of it back. There is no fresh run-up yet.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: Final 2–4 weeks before the DMC assessment

postWin.note: ISEE (Iveric) on GATHER2 GA Phase 3 topline: opened ~+33%, closed ~+66% on the day (Zacks), and ~+86% for the week (Motley Fool). ANNX is smaller and more depressed, so the upside is plausibly larger.

postLose.note: APLS fell ~38% in a day on a GA safety signal (Jul 2023). ALLK fell ~88% when a Phase 2/3 missed its symptom endpoints (Dec 2021). A Month-15 miss with a Month-24 continuation likely lands in between.

spotSizing.reason: 2.5%. phase3_readout has no n≥5 turbo bucket (context only). Lane-wide prior (hitRate 6.5%, softHitRate 27.1%, beatBench 71%, n=107) and a WAIT macro tape (30/100) keep turbo sizing at the low end of 2–5%.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the turbo medianMAE (-20%). A break below ~$2.65 before the event means the market is pricing a bad outcome.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If the Month-15 endpoint misses, exit day 1. The Month-24 continuation is not a reason to hold through a ~50%+ gap.

comparableCases.note: Same indication, same pivotal-readout shape. This is the template for an ANNX win, though ANNX's BCVA endpoint is more differentiated than lesion growth.
GA intravitreal sentiment can reverse in a day. This is the downside shape for any safety surprise in ARCHER II.
Worst-case template: hitting a biomarker but missing the clinical endpoint wipes out a single-asset small cap.

th.summary: รีเฟรช (thesis ไม่เปลี่ยน ลง 16% ตามตลาด): งบ Q3 (9 พ.ย.) ยืนยัน ARCHER II (vonaprument ใน geographic atrophy โปรแกรม GA แรกที่มุ่งรักษาการมองเห็นแทนการลดขนาดรอยโรค) ยังเดินตามแผนประกาศ topline Q4 2026 และ BLA ของ tanruprubart ใน GBS ในสหรัฐฯ ก็มีกำหนด Q4 ขณะที่ EMA กำลังพิจารณา MAA เงินสด $213M พอถึงปี 2028 จึงไม่ติด survival flag การลงมาที่ $3.53 เป็นเรื่องของกลุ่ม ปรับ Base ลงเป็น $7.06 (+100%) ตาม bias ของ Base ใน turbo (+52.5pp เทียบ P75 30 วันจริง +21.5%) เป้า Bull/Moon เท่าเดิม median ถึงวัน catalyst ของ turbo -6.6% (n=76) จึงเข้าที่ Entry 2 เป็นหลัก แนะนำ 2–3% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า ARCHER II พลาด ลงได้ 50–60%
th.priceNote: ราคาสด $3.53 (+1.73%) 18 พ.ย. 2026 ลง 16% จากรายงาน 11 พ.ย. ($4.21) โดยไม่มีข่าวร้ายของบริษัท ไบโอเทคเล็กโดนเทขายพร้อมที่ S&P ทำจุดต่ำสุดรอบ 5 เดือน 17 พ.ย. งบ Q3 (9 พ.ย.) ยืนยัน topline ARCHER II ใน Q4 2026 และ BLA tanruprubart ในสหรัฐฯ ใน Q4 เงินสด $213M พอถึงปี 2028

ไม่มีวันแน่นอน: "Q4 2026" อาจเลื่อนไปต้นปี 2027 และผลจาก DMC อาจออกมาโดยไม่มีการเตือนล่วงหน้า
